correctness.rationale: For each \(n\ge3\) the literal outside-neighbor characterization is an equivalence. Every nonconstant admissible cyclic core word decomposes uniquely into m positive one-runs separated by m zero-runs of length at least two. Stars-and-bars with an \(n/m\) distinguished-run factor counts all labelled patterns without duplication. Exactly \(n-2m\) pendant positions are optional. This proves the exact joint polynomial for all n; a separate four-state transfer determinant proves the size recurrence. The standalone verifier directly checks all graph subsets for \(3\le n\le9\) and independently checks the complete transfer/sum/recurrence for \(3\le n\le22\). No finite computation is used as infinite proof.

value.rationale: Theorem evaluates a natural \(\#\mathsf P\)-complete graph-convexity counting invariant on the canonical pendant-cycle unicyclic family. Unlike known scalar A073313, the bivariate distribution identifies all separate core and leaf cardinalities, an exact run-number/count structure and the run-length-independent free-leaf law.
